text: Yes, the firm should migrate to the new records platform. The vendor's audited rollback path guarantees that any issues can be addressed promptly without significant downtime, ensuring a smooth transition. Moreover, its automated cross-linking of case files offers unparalleled convenience for researchers, as it eliminates the need for manual searches across multiple systems. Additionally, combining licenses will result in substantial cost savings—by a third! This aligns with our sister office's experience, where they successfully migrated to this platform last year with no glitches. Combining these factors makes the upgrade highly beneficial for improving efficiency and streamlining operations.
